commits.title: Add changelog capture scenes script for rendering synthetic documentation
commits.before_text: Release evidence relied on earlier capture/editor behavior, and the Management page loaded unrelated tab data. Form-editor and festive-effect interactions used their previous handling.
commits.after_text: Adds offline exact-revision capture for UI, documentation and behavior reports; all-change evidence requirements, actionable draft recovery, automatic publication and paginated comparison editors. Management isolates changelog queries. Also includes form-editor and festive-effect refinements, v56.6-v56.8 evidence and regression coverage.

comparisons.title: Repository change report — Changelog capture, Management and festive effects
comparisons.before_text: Release evidence relied on earlier capture/editor behavior, and the Management page loaded unrelated tab data. Form-editor and festive-effect interactions used their previous handling. Evidence: exact first-parent file metadata, not a UI screenshot.
comparisons.after_text: Adds offline exact-revision capture for UI, documentation and behavior reports; all-change evidence requirements, actionable draft recovery, automatic publication and paginated comparison editors. Management isolates changelog queries. Also includes form-editor and festive-effect refinements, v56.6-v56.8 evidence and regression coverage. Evidence: exact change-revision file metadata, not a UI screenshot.
comparisons.capture_note: Packaged automatic report capture, recipe repository-change. Exact Git snapshots; synthetic fixtures; browser scripts/traffic disabled. Repository change report; not a UI screenshot. No source code or live data is displayed.
